test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F is an immediate neighbour of A. D sits second to the right of E. B is an immediate neighbour of E and sits second to the right of C. F sits second to the right of D. A is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who is sitting between D and E?
solution: Given: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) D sits second to the right of E. 2) F sits second to the right of D.
